Mod.Name: PSX Triad HD Restoration
Mod.Author: YoRHa Numberless
Mod.Description:
PSX TRIAD HD RESTORATION Fully replaces the Triple Triad textures with a faithful, high-definition recreation of the original PSX design.
► CARD DESIGN All 110 cards artwork and layout faithful to the original PSX version.
► NUMBERS AND CHARACTERS Card power numbering, score, affinity bonus and typeface restored.
► ELEMENTAL ICONS Fire, Ice, Thunder, Wind, Earth, Water, Poison and Holy, recreated in good quality.
► GAME BOARD AND PLAYMAT Challenging screen, grid and background also reworked.
► CARDS BACK AND FRAME PSX-style card back design and frames with their decorative elements and shape.

LatestVersion.ReleaseNotes: —1.0: Initial release for FFVIII Remastered. —1.1: Several pose, color and resolution corrections and adjustments for accuracy purposes. Some models reworked. —1.2: Abadon Card tweaked. Elemental Icons reworked. Power value Numbers adjusted. General alignment corrections. Junction VIII version released.
